title: Use Regulations
previewText: The provisions of Section 109-11 (Special Use Regulations) shall apply, except that all uses under Use Group VI that are subject to a size limitation of 10,000 square feet of floor area per establishment, shall be further limited to a maximum size of 5,000 square feet of floor area per establishment.
